summary: Attach exact immutable parser-text citations to detected workflow conflict sources.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user requires evidence to appear with the corresponding result
A synthetic fixture proved that detected workflow conflicts exposed only file-level provenance despite exact immutable evidence
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective and inline-evidence requirement authorize this deterministic citation improvement.
known_limitations: Citation lookup is bounded to the first 32 distinct detected conflict documents; every source still retains file-level provenance.
A source without an exact identity-plus-status phrase in parser/OCR text remains uncited even if its document summary contains a detected status.
A status phrase naming another workflow in the same fragment remains uncited for the requested workflow.
Manual classification corrections intentionally do not receive parser-text citations.
The guard preserves ambiguity and does not determine chronology, revision precedence, authority or contractual correctness.
